question: Identify the chemical formula of methyl chloride from the following chemicals.
solution:
The correct answer is __**CH₃Cl**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Methyl chloride:-**

 
 
• **It also known as chloromethane or Refrigerant-40, is an organic compound with the chemical formula CH₃Cl. **
 
• It is a colorless, sweet-smelling, flammable gas that is used in a variety of industrial applications.
 
• Methyl chloride is produced by the reaction of methanol with hydrogen chloride. It can also be produced by the chlorination of methane.
 
• Methyl chloride is used in a variety of industrial applications, including:
 
 
• **Refrigerant**: Methyl chloride was formerly used as a refrigerant, but it has been phased out due to its environmental concerns.
 
• **Fumigant:** Methyl chloride is used as a fumigant to control pests in stored grain and other products.
 
• **Methylating agent**: Methyl chloride is used as a methylating agent to attach CH3 groups to other molecules.
 
• **Silicone production**: Methyl chloride is used in the production of silicone polymer
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Methane:-**

 
 
• **CH₄ is a chemical compound with the simplest alkane and the main constituent of natural gas. **
 
• It is a colorless, odorless gas that is flammable and has a boiling point of -161.5 °C (-258.7 °F) and a melting point of -182.5 °C (-294.5 °F).
 
 
 
• **Ethane:-**
 
 
• **It is a naturally occurring organic compound with the chemical formula C₂H₆.**
 
• At standard temperature and pressure, ethane is a colorless, odorless gas. It is the second simplest alkane, after methane, and is the main component of natural gas.
 
 
 
• **Acetylene or ethyne:-**
 
 
• **C₂H₂ is the simplest alkyne, a chemical compound with the formula H−C≡C−H. **
 
• It is a colorless gas with a faint, garlic-like odor. Acetylene is highly flammable and unstable, and it is often handled in a solution.
